mintAuthority.summary: NXUSD is a BoringOwnable CDP stablecoin with two independent native issuance deployments. On Avalanche, mint() is onlyOwner under Gnosis Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, a 2-of-3 Safe with no modules or guard; on Polygon, owner-only minting is controlled by Gnosis Safe 0xc4eca7d55db3dc217a2edfff3da05fca4d8a7ef8, also 2-of-3 with no modules or guard. Both owner Safes administer their native NXUSD deployment and Nereus CDP parameters.

mintIncidents.summary: A flash-loan manipulation of the AVAX/USDC JLP collateral price let an attacker borrow far more NXUSD than justified by collateral, creating about $500K of NXUSD bad debt.

controls.label: Nereus NXUSD owner multisig (2/3 Gnosis Safe)
controls.capDescription: NXUSD uses BoringOwnable; mint() rate-limits to 15% of total supply per 24h window.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90243848, NXUSD owner() remained Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467. The Safe was 2-of-3 with no modules, zero guard and module guard, fixed singleton 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea, and standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0x017062a1de2fe6b99be3d9d37841fed19f573804. NXUSD is a direct 5007-byte deployment whose EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero. Verified source shows mint() is onlyOwner with a 15% per-24h rate limiter.

controls.label: Nereus Polygon NXUSDV2 owner multisig (2/3 Gnosis Safe)
controls.capDescription: NXUSDV2 uses owner-only minting with the same 15% of total supply per 24h rolling rate limit as the Avalanche deployment.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92137867, NXUSDV2 owner() returned Safe 0xc4eca7d55db3dc217a2edfff3da05fca4d8a7ef8 and the token had non-empty direct-contract bytecode. The Safe proxy delegated to Safe Singleton L2 1.3.0 at 0x3e5c63644e683549055b9be8653de26e0b4cd36e; getThreshold() returned 2 and getOwners() returned the same three signers as the Avalanche owner Safe. At that block, getModulesPaginated() returned an empty module list and the Safe guard storage slot was zero. Verified Polygon source exposes owner-only mint with the same 15%-per-24h rolling rate limiter; the token's EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero.

review.evidence: NXUSD has two independent native issuance surfaces rather than one canonical deployment plus a bridge representation. At Avalanche block 90243848, the direct 5007-byte NXUSD deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Its onlyOwner mint path remained controlled by Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, still 2-of-3 with no modules or guard. At Polygon block 92137867, direct NXUSDV2 owner-only minting remained controlled by Safe 0xc4eca7d55db3dc217a2edfff3da05fca4d8a7ef8, whose threshold was 2, signer count 3, module list empty, and guard storage zero; the Polygon token also had no EIP-1967 implementation, admin, or beacon slots. Both owner Safes can mint repeatedly under a rolling 15%-of-supply daily limit, while no whole-supply collateral reconciliation, independent attestation, or named prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Nereus dashboards, deployment records, DefiLlama, and the Ambisafe code audit did not provide assets-and-liabilities reconciliation across Avalanche and Polygon. Sol reconciliation adjudication 2026-08-15: the owner Safes' repeatable onlyOwner mint paths exist outside borrower-facing CDP collateral gating; because no whole-supply collateral reconciliation covering those escape paths is evidenced, reconciliation is applicable but unknown.
